AWS Cloud Application Developer - MuleSoft 
 Req number: 
R8855 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Hybrid 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated AWS Cloud Application Developer - MuleSoft ready to take us to the next level! If you have MuleSoft development experience, AWS cloud application development, and Kubernetes/Amazon EKS expertise and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a AWS Cloud Application Developer - MuleSoft to build MuleSoft integrations on Amazon EKS and NJ SPIRIT interfaces through the API Module for key initiatives supporting our clients’ initiatives. This position will be Full-Time and Hybrid in Trenton, NJ . With employees expected to work onsite 3 days per week.
 Only work authorizations that will not require sponsorship now or in the future will be considered. Preference will be given to local candidates. 
 What You'll Do 
 Build, deploy, and support MuleSoft applications running on Amazon EKS
 Implement interfaces through the API Module following MuleSoft integration standards
 Develop DataWeave transformations and error handling for integration flows
 Implement REST APIs using AWS Lambda and API Gateway
 Build and maintain data access solutions utilizing RDS for PostgreSQL
 Implement event-driven services through an external write gateway
 Write automated unit tests
 Participate in Git-based workflows, pull request reviews, and CI/CD activities
 Create interface documentation, deployment procedures, and runbooks
 Collaborate with developers, architects, and QA teams
 Support integration testing and defect resolution
 What You'll Need 
 Required
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 5+ years of software development experience
 Hands-on MuleSoft development experience including DataWeave
 Experience deploying applications to Amazon EKS or Kubernetes
 Experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and RDS for PostgreSQL
 Experience implementing REST APIs based on published contracts
 Experience writing automated unit tests
 Experience with Git-based development and pull request reviews
 Preferred
 Event-driven service architecture experience
 Experience integrating through external write gateways
 AWS Certified Developer Associate
 MuleSoft Certified Developer
 Experience integrating with child welfare or human services systems
 Experience supporting State of New Jersey agencies
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform essential job functions consistent with ADA and other standards
 Ability to conduct repetitive computer tasks utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
 Must be able to communicate with customers and team members over the phone and in person
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional movement
